news.title: Clarity Act text lets crypto firms offer stablecoin rewards while shielding bank yield
news.summary: The text released Friday blocks crypto firms from offering stablecoin yield offerings that look like bank deposits, but "bona fide" transactions are allowed.

news.title: Bitcoin miner Riot's shares jump 8% after expanding AMD data center deal, signaling AI pivot
news.summary: AMD’s expansion and improved financing terms highlight Riot’s shift beyond bitcoin mining and strengthen confidence in its growing data center business.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation finalizes sale of 10,000 ether to BitMine as part of its treasury strategy
news.summary: The latest transaction follows a similar March deal in which the foundation sold 5,000 ETH to BitMine, raising roughly $10.2 million.
